column3: DYNAMIC LOADING. Vendor /home/resources/icon-master/ipl/cfuncs (bitcount.c internal.c lgconv.c pack.c + icall.h, and see external.c on the extlvals row) into this package and build a libcfunc.so against out/libscrip_rt.so, which already exports 10 of the 12 iconx internals the upstream library binds (alcexternal alcfile alcreal alcstr cnv_c_str cnv_int cnv_real cnv_str getdbl nulldesc; the missing palnum and rgbkey are ppm.c graphics only and neither program touches them). Then teach the runner to put it on pathload's path (iconx does this by exporting FPATH=". <its own bin>"; we set no FPATH and pathload falls back to ".").
